source.title: Mirael - Scarlet Sorceress
source.name: Mirael
source.description: A destructive Mage who is feeble but skilled at dealing high damage.

skills.name: Winged Flame

description.raw: Mirael selects a direction and summons a 3-tile wide wall of flame, dealing 600% (ATK-based) + 60% (SP-based) damage to burned enemies.
